why: Songs Australia voted for rather than bought: the triple j Hottest 100 for every year from 1993 to 2025, the Hottest 100 of the 2010s, the APRA Top 30 Australian songs, Triple M's Ozzest 100, and the Kent year-end top 25 for 1956 to 1969, which the 9 September run left out because it started at 1970. Everything here was missing from the library, clears the bar in tools/pull-known-songs.py and has a real preview clip. pack_additions go on the END of each pack.
